summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for CreativeStore. 18/18 pytest cases passed covering products, orders, affiliates, withdrawals, admin auth, commission flow, refund-on-reject. Frontend verified across Storefront, Partnership, Affiliate, Admin routes including referral banner, order modal, admin login + tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: Withdrawal flow holds balance correctly on request and refunds on rejection - good pattern.
Order status update properly blocks re-processing (returns 400 for non-pending).
Commission calculation uses discounted price when discount_active (price=15000 * 12% = 1800 verified).
All /api/admin/* endpoints correctly require X-Admin-Password header (401 without).
Mongo _id is excluded via projection {_id: 0} in all queries - good.
Suggest hashing admin password in production rather than plain compare with env value (low priority for MVP).
AffiliateCreate has no input validation length/regex - any string accepted (minor).
